context.opening_question: What would make Södra Öland an even better place to live, work and visit?

current_situation: Youth participation pilot completed successfully. Young people responded well to creative ownership. Evening timing worked. Some would return for the festival.

goals.desired_direction: Increase meaningful youth participation in the festival
Strengthen cooperation between local businesses during the festival
Improve evening transport options for visitors

history.reason: Municipality won't fund evening buses this year.

missions.purpose: To establish a grounded understanding of young people's needs and priorities and create a concrete basis for designing more meaningful participation in Skördefesten.
missions.description: Recruit 6–10 young people from at least two communities in Södra Öland. Hold a 60–90 minute discussion or workshop, in person or online, asking: what would make Skördefesten worth participating in, what barriers exist, what roles or activities would feel meaningful, and how should youth contributions be made visible? Document the responses, group them into themes, and select up to three ideas for possible pilot testing.
definition_of_done: 6–10 young people have contributed, representing at least two communities in Södra Öland
Participants have identified specific barriers and desired forms of involvement
The input has been documented without attributing statements unnecessarily to individuals
Up to three feasible participation ideas have been prioritised by the participants
Each prioritised idea includes a short note on what support, decision, or resource would be needed to test it
missions.result: Pilot completed. Five young people co-designed a guided night walk combining local nature and storytelling.

observations.text: Young people were highly engaged when they had creative control. The proposed evening time worked well. Three participants said they would return for the festival.

decisions.context: Run a short, youth-led listening and idea-gathering activity before or during the 2026 festival period, involving young people from different parts of Södra Öland.
Improve evening transport options for visitors
decisions.reason: Municipality won't fund evening buses this year.
